dataset_description: 10,000 synthetic patient records with standard ICU vital-sign distributions (non-restricted demonstration data)

tele_triage_sos_latencies_ms.description: Measures CPU JSON serialization, SHA-256 telemetry hashing, and payload/status preparation (does not measure complete SOS application dispatch or network I/O)

assumptions.note: Theoretical storage gas and transaction models; excludes unmeasured external IPFS pinning fees

tamper_alert_gas.attribution_note: 30,652 gas is the asserted Hardhat EVM receipt for emitTamperAlert() in test/medblock.test.js. tamperProtectedUpdate() is functionally tested for non-reverting execution, event persistence, and record-state preservation.

crypto_latencies_ms.sum_of_mean_component_latencies_note: Arithmetic sum of the four separate operation means (0.2146 + 0.3672 + 0.2420 + 0.1731 = 0.9969 ms ~0.997 ms); arithmetic sum of component means, not an independently timed end-to-end pipeline latency

local_telemetry_processing_microbenchmar.description: Measures CPU JSON serialization, SHA-256 telemetry hashing, and payload/status preparation (does not measure complete SOS application dispatch or network I/O)

theoretical_wan_cellular_model_ms.description: Local microbenchmark latency + theoretical 18-45 ms 5G/cellular transit delay model

storage_cost_scenario_analysis.model_classification: Illustrative scenario assumptions and theoretical gas models (not measured live Polygon transaction receipts)

scenario_a_10000_records.description: 10,000 structured clinical EHR records (~256 bytes each = 2.56 MB total)
scenario_a_10000_records.derivation_notes: Native on-chain: 10,000 * 8 words * 20,000 gas = 1,600,000,000 gas. MedBlock anchor: 9,600,000 gas is an illustrative scenario assumption (~960 gas/record amortized batch anchor, vs 200,000,000 gas for 10k individual SSTORE slots). Stated 320 KB CID storage represents 10k * 32-byte hash footprint.

scenario_b_10mb_bulk_file.description: Single 10 MiB bulk imaging/DICOM file (10,485,760 bytes = 327,680 words)
scenario_b_10mb_bulk_file.derivation_notes: Native on-chain: 327,680 words * 20,000 gas = 6,553,600,000 gas. MedBlock anchor: 84,210 gas is an illustrative single-transaction model (21,000 base + metadata writes + event log) for registering the IPFS CID on-chain.

tamper_defense_gas_audit.verification_note: Imported constant reference asserted from actual Hardhat EVM receipt for emitTamperAlert() in test/medblock.test.js (not independently measured by benchmark script). tamperProtectedUpdate() is functionally tested for non-reverting execution, event persistence, and record-state preservation without a separate gas assertion.
